## Core Capabilities & 12 Specialized Services
1. **Building Construction (Main Service):** Turnkey commercial, residential, and industrial building construction, reinforced concrete foundations, structural framing, exterior envelope, and architectural finishing compliant with the Saudi Building Code (SBC).
2. **Roads Construction:** Comprehensive road construction, highway engineering, laser subgrade grading, hot-mix asphalt paving, curbstone installation, and compound roadways (MOT & MOMRA compliant).
3. **Excavations:** Bulk earthmoving, heavy limestone rock breaking, deep multi-level basement excavation, pipeline trenching, and site leveling with high-capacity crawler excavators.
4. **Transport:** TGA-licensed heavy freight transport (License 11/00052742), lowbed trailers up to 100T, 40ft flatbeds, 3-ton dynas, and bulk aggregate tippers.
5. **Rental Equipment:** Extensive construction machinery rental: Excavators (20T-45T), dumpers (16-32m³), mobile cranes (25-100T), dynas, and pickups on daily, monthly, or annual leases with certified operators.
6. **Supply Construction Material:** Direct bulk supply of SASO-certified aggregates, graded sub-base, sand, structural steel rebar (Grade 60), ready-mix concrete, and masonry blocks.
7. **Manpower Supply:** Certified skilled construction labor: Heavy equipment operators, shuttering carpenters, rebar steel fixers, masons, MEP technicians, and safety officers under Qiwa/Ajeer.
8. **Scrap Works:** Industrial scrap metal purchasing, structural steel dismantling, demolition rebar recovery, site metal clearance, and certified recycling disposal.
9. **Paint Works:** Interior emulsion painting, exterior weather-shield acrylic textured profile coatings, heavy-duty epoxy floor systems, and industrial anti-corrosive coatings.
10. **Construction Laboratory Work:** On-site and certified laboratory testing: Concrete compressive cube crushing (7 & 28-day), soil Proctor compaction, asphalt testing, and SASO compliance reports.
11. **Diesel and Petrol Supply:** 24/7 direct jobsite bulk fuel logistics, certified mobile bowsers, and road tankers refueling plant machinery, generators, and vehicle fleets without downtime.
12. **Contracting Work:** Turnkey general contracting, civil and structural engineering, MEP infrastructure, and comprehensive project management from inception to handover.

## Standards & Compliance
- Full adherence to the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and SASO standards.
- Ministry of Commerce (CR 2050172727), ZATCA VAT (311814159600003), and TGA Naql License (11/00052742).
- WhatsApp-first rapid estimating, fleet dispatch, and tender evaluation workflow.
